channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Top Pick: Subway: Sub of the Day: $4.99 six-inch sub
item.guid: Subway-Sub of the Day: $4.99 six-inch sub-2026-09-15
item.description: A different featured six-inch sub is $4.99 every day as part of Subway's Fresh Value Menu; add chips and a drink for $2 more. (Ongoing)

item.title: El Pollo Loco: $5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value Menu
item.guid: El Pollo Loco-$5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value M-2026-09-15
item.description: A rotating lineup of roughly $5 combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, taquitos and more) built on citrus-marinated fire-grilled chicken, every day at participating locations. Lineup and pricing vary by market. (West & Southwest only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Noodles & Company: Delicious Duos from $9.95
item.description: Pick a small entree with a protein and a side like Caesar salad or broccoli, served all day at participating locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: McAlister's Deli: Choose Two Combo for $7.39
item.description: Mix and match any two items from sandwiches, salads, soups, spuds and starters for one low price, every day. (South & Central US only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Tijuana Flats: Taco Tuesdaze: two tacos, chips and a drink for $7.99
item.guid: Tijuana Flats-Taco Tuesdaze: two tacos, chips and a dr-2026-09-15
item.description: Every Tuesday, get two tacos with your choice of protein plus chips and a drink for $7.99, dine-in, app or online. (FL & Southeast only) (Ongoing (Tuesdays only))

item.title: Rubio's Coastal Grill: $7+ Meal Menu, including Fish & Chips for $7.99
item.guid: Rubio's Coastal Grill-$7+ Meal Menu, including Fish & Chip-2026-09-15
item.description: Rubio's everyday value menu features meals from $7 to $10, including the new Fish & Chips at $7.99. (CA, AZ & NV only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Naf Naf Grill: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
item.guid: Naf Naf Grill-$9.99 Pita Meal Deal-2026-09-15
item.description: Naf Naf's biggest value yet: a full pita meal for $9.99 at participating locations. (Midwest & East only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Salad and Go: Salads and wraps from $7.75
item.guid: Salad and Go-Salads and wraps from $7.75-2026-09-15

item.guid: WaBa Grill-Value-Bowl Combo: mini bowl, side and dr-2026-09-15

item.title: Publix: Sub of the Week: $2 off a featured whole deli sub
item.guid: Publix-Sub of the Week: $2 off a featured whole-2026-09-15
